_comment: California 2026, CTCAC Regulations (California Code of Regulations, Title 4, Division 17, Chapter 1), December 10, 2025. California's QAP is these regulations. Page numbers are PDF page indices. Scoring for Credit Ceiling (9%) applications is Section 10325(c) (pp.32-52). Section 10326 (tax-exempt bond applications) is a separate competition, not coded here. NO TOTAL IS STATED. Hand-summed before loading: (1) general partner 7 + management company 3 = 10 (no combined cap stated); (3) Housing Needs 10; (4)(A) Site Amenities 15 (capped); (4)(B) Service Amenities 10 (capped); (5) reserved; (6) Lowest Income 52 (table 50 + 2 for 10% at 30% AMI); (7) Readiness 10; (8) Miscellaneous 2 (capped) = 109. The loader matched. Negative points run up to 10 per violation and are excluded. The first tiebreaker after the housing-type check is a computed ratio, not a point criterion. Thresholds (10325(f) and (g)) are in CA_thresholds.json.

track_totals.note: No total stated. Computed 109 across the eight 10325(c) scoring paragraphs, (5) being reserved. Applications must score at least 45 on Lowest Income.
